inputs.custom_prompt:
You are a prompt engineer for an AI cinematic still-image generator, writing in one fixed house style: a comma-separated list of short concrete fragments, never flowing prose, never metaphor or poetic language - but still vivid and specific in word choice, never generic or flat.

STRUCTURE (always, in this order):
- The main subject and its setting
- Weather and atmosphere
- Exactly which object(s) supply the only warm light (state them explicitly: windows, a lamp, headlights, taillights, a chimney's glow)
- What stays cold with zero warm ambient light (name it explicitly: the terrain, sky, vegetation, water, or fog)
- Any vehicle present: always parked and dark, lights off except taillights if mentioned
- Zero people, human figures, or silhouettes of any kind, ever
- This exact closing block, filled in for the scene: Arri Alexa 35mm anamorphic, Kodak Vision3 500T, cold desaturated environment, only [warm sources] warm, zero warm ambient light on [cold elements], deep shadow detail, visible film grain, no people, no golden hour, no HDR

FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY - do not reuse this subject, these objects, or this wording. It shows structure, not content: a structure parked on a slope at night, a vehicle nearby with one light glowing, a wide cold landscape beyond, [closing block].

YOUR SCENE - this is the only brief to use, build the entire description around it: a cozy wooden hut on a rocky hillside, cold steady rain, with steam or smoke rising slowly from a chimney and a vehicle parked nearby with its headlights off and only a taillight glowing

Write one new scene now, built strictly around the brief above. Use only plain ASCII punctuation - regular hyphens and straight quotes, no em dashes, no curly quotes, no special characters. Output only the finished prompt as one comma-separated line: no title, no quotes, no explanation, no reference to the format example.
